action_name.value: Alphabet Inc. self-preferencing in ranking action

value.label: self-preferencing in ranking
value.quote: shall not treat more favourably, in ranking and related indexing and crawling, services and products offered by the gatekeeper itself than similar services or products of a third party

status.note: Appeal status not stated in the decision

quantified.quote: the Commission concludes that Alphabet gives its products unit and its product ads unit more favourable treatment in ranking on Google Search, as compared to similar services offered by third parties.

nature.quote: the Commission concludes that Alphabet gives its products unit and its product ads unit more favourable treatment in ranking on Google Search, as compared to similar services offered by third parties.

description.value: Third-party services are ranked less prominently on Google Search compared to Alphabet’s own distinct or additional services, limiting their visibility and ability to compete. This reduces opportunities for third-party services to reach users and generate traffic or revenue.
description.quote: the Commission concludes that Alphabet gives its products unit and its product ads unit more favourable treatment in ranking on Google Search, as compared to similar services offered by third parties.

number.quote: Alphabet does not comply with Article 6(5) of Regulation (EU) 2022/1925 with regard to Alphabet’s online search engine (“OSE”) core

identifiable.quote: Third parties offer services, which have similar functionalities to those of Alphabet’s flight intermediation service that is ranked on and embedded in the SERP.

categories.quote: Third parties offer services, which have similar functionalities to those of Alphabet’s flight intermediation service that is ranked on and embedded in the SERP.

proof_of_membership.value: having a website indexed by Google Search and providing similar services to those offered by Alphabet in the relevant categories (e.g., comparison shopping services, vertical search services, or other intermediation services).
proof_of_membership.quote: Third parties offer services, which have similar functionalities to those of Alphabet’s flight intermediation service that is ranked on and embedded in the SERP.

value: vertical search services (VSSs) for flights, trains, lodging, and local places

facts.quote: The Commission finds that Alphabet’s non-compliance with Article 6(5) of Regulation (EU) 2022/1925 commenced on the date when that provision became applicable to it, that is on 7 March 2024, which is six months after the online search engine Google Search was listed in the Alphabet designation decision. This non-compliance is still ongoing at the date of adoption of this Decision.
